name: Customer Totals
query:
SELECT 
    c.name AS customer,

    -- Legal Jobs Total per Currency
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lj.currency = 'RWF' THEN lj.total_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_legal_jobs_rwf,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lj.currency = 'USD' THEN lj.total_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_legal_jobs_usd,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lj.currency = 'EUR' THEN lj.total_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_legal_jobs_eur,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lj.currency = 'GBP' THEN lj.total_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_legal_jobs_gbp,

    -- Total Invoices in Company Currency (Converted)
    COALESCE(SUM(si.base_grand_total), 0) AS total_invoices_company_currency,

    -- Total Payments in Company Currency
    COALESCE(SUM(p.base_paid_amount), 0) AS total_payments_company_currency,
    "USD" AS currency_usd,
    "EUR" AS currency_eur,
    "GBP" AS currency_gbp

FROM `tabCustomer` c
LEFT JOIN `tabLegal Job` lj ON c.name = lj.customer
LEFT JOIN `tabSales Invoice` si ON c.name = si.customer
LEFT JOIN `tabPayment Entry` p ON c.name = p.party AND p.party_type = 'Customer'

WHERE 
    IFNULL(%(customer)s, '') = '' OR c.name = %(customer)s;
